name: microservice-mesh
description: A realistic order-processing system split into independent services that talk over a message broker: an API gateway, an orders service, a payments service, an inventory service, and a notifications worker. Deliberately polyglot (Go gateway, TypeScript services, a Python worker) to show the same contracts across languages. Each service is containerized, wired together with docker-compose, then deployed to Kubernetes with Helm and an HPA.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && go vet -C services/gateway ./... && python3 -m compileall -q python
scripts.test: vitest run && go test -C services/gateway -race ./... && python3 -m unittest discover -s python -p 'test_*.py' -v
